# Task Status Requirements Checklist: Random Gallery

**Purpose**: Review the clarity, completeness, and consistency of task-status and acceptance-evidence requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [Random Gallery](../spec.md)
**Context**: [Tasks](../tasks.md), [task audit](../task-audit.md), [verification record](../validation.md).
**Focus**: Completion evidence and blocked-work reporting.
**Depth**: Standard.
**Audience/Timing**: Reviewer, before accepting a task-status or completion report.

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist status tasks` using the recent evidence audit as context.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact.
Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the written requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements-quality approval; it does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are task-status requirements defined for incomplete, implemented-but-unverified, blocked, and verified work? [Completeness, Tasks §Organization; Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Are required acceptance evidence and its connection to each task ID specified? [Completeness, Tasks §Notes; Task Audit §Task acceptance and evidence audit]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements for reporting completed totals and remaining task IDs documented? [Completeness, Tasks §Notes; Validation §Remaining unchecked task IDs]
- [ ] CHK004 Are blocker-reporting requirements explicit about the cause, affected tasks, and minimum action needed to resume? [Completeness, Task Audit §Specific external dependencies]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the meaning of a completed task checkbox clearly separated from source or test-document availability? [Clarity, Tasks §Organization]
- [ ] CHK006 Are reviewer checklist approval and implementation completion explicitly distinguished in the written status rules? [Clarity, Tasks §Notes; Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Are passed, failed, skipped, not-run, and infrastructure-error reporting categories defined without overlap? [Clarity, Validation §Browser execution counts; Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the required evidence standard clear for partially satisfied tasks whose remaining criteria are blocked? [Clarity, Tasks §Implementation Status and Tooling Blockers; Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are phase checkpoint descriptions consistent with the evidence-based completion rule, rather than ambiguous statements of current completion? [Consistency, Tasks §Phase 3; Tasks §Phase 5; Conflict]
- [ ] CHK010 Are task totals and completion terminology consistent across task notes, the task audit, and the verification summary requirements? [Consistency, Tasks §Notes; Task Audit §Previously completed tasks reopened]
- [ ] CHK011 Are approved evidence requirements and documented tooling deviations reconciled without silently lowering acceptance criteria? [Consistency, Plan §Implementation Tooling Update; Tasks §T002; Conflict]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements for returning an unsupported completion claim to unchecked status explicitly documented? [Consistency, Task Audit §Previously completed tasks reopened]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Does each task have an objectively decidable completion condition rather than only a deliverable name? [Measurability, Tasks §T001–T046; Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements for evidence provenance sufficient to identify the relevant task, artifact, environment, and result? [Measurability, Plan §Verification Strategy; Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Are partial unit-level evidence and end-to-end acceptance evidence distinguished for the corresponding product criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-004; Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK016 Are performance, accessibility, and first-time-user acceptance thresholds precise enough to support an unambiguous status decision? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005–SC-007]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are status requirements defined for infrastructure failure before any product acceptance evidence is produced? [Coverage, Validation §Browser execution counts]
- [ ] CHK018 Are recovery requirements specified for resuming blocked work without treating the earlier blocker as a passing outcome? [Coverage, Tasks §Implementation Status and Tooling Blockers; Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements for retaining task identity and historical evidence after reopening a task documented? [Coverage, Task Audit §Previously completed tasks reopened; Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements for interpreting historical totals when acceptance coverage expands clearly documented? [Clarity, Validation §Browser execution counts; Gap]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Review Ownership

- [ ] CHK021 Are environment, dependency-availability, and permission assumptions stated as conditions rather than product defects or acceptance waivers? [Dependencies, Spec §A-008; Tasks §Implementation Status and Tooling Blockers]
- [ ] CHK022 Are physical-device and participant evidence requirements distinguished from browser viewport emulation and source-level assessment? [Coverage, Spec §SC-005–SC-007; Tasks §T040; Tasks §T043–T044]
- [ ] CHK023 Are responsibilities for resolving external blockers and supplying manual evidence documented? [Completeness, Task Audit §Specific external dependencies; Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Is reviewer ownership of this checklist and the scope of its approval clearly defined, including the separation from tasks.md status? [Clarity, Gap]

## Notes

- All newly generated items are unchecked; this command has not evaluated or approved them.
- `[Gap]`, `[Conflict]`, and related markers identify review questions, not established findings.
- References identify requirements and reporting rules to review, not application behavior to test.
- The recorded task snapshot is 9/46 verified and 37 unchecked. That snapshot is context, not
  a checklist result or a new verification run.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist status as a gate and must not modify these reviewer markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` retains its separate built-in lifecycle and is unchanged.
- No application files, task statuses, acceptance requirements, or existing checklist content
  are changed by this checklist generation.
